description: RETROFIT-LAT contains information on 1,010 residential-building energy-efficiency projects supported by the Latvian Environmental Investment Fund. The fund and the National Technical University of Athens publish separate retrofit and solar-installation tables, with energy consumption, emissions and building characteristics before and after intervention. GitHub provides redacted CSV files and preprocessing material; Zenodo preserves release 1.1.2. The licence file states CC BY 4.0, so reuse is free. The public release has limitations: addresses and project identifiers are removed, locations are pseudonymised and dates are generalised to years. The README gives an ambiguous 1870–2022 range that may include construction dates, so it is not adopted as the intervention period. The data can calibrate retrofit-benefit and investment scenarios alongside model-energyplus, while the selected funded projects should not be treated as a national building-stock sample.
